{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_112",
      "title": "Key Vault key is not backed by an HSM",
      "resource": "azurerm_key_vault_key.generated",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The key uses the software-protected RSA key type, so its cryptographic material is not protected by a hardware security module."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource "azurerm_key_vault_key" "generated" {
  name         = "terragoat-generated-certificate-${var.environment}"
  key_vault_id = azurerm_key_vault.example.id
  key_type     = "RSA-HSM"
  key_size     = 2048
  key_opts = [
    "decrypt",
    "encrypt",
    "sign",
    "unwrapKey",
    "verify",
    "wrapKey",
  ]
}
",
  "fix_summary": "Changed the key type from software-protected RSA to RSA-HSM so the Key Vault key is backed by an HSM. The referenced Key Vault must use a SKU that supports HSM-backed keys."
}
